label: Three synthetic development coding tasks, not held-out benchmarks

tasks.task: Fix refund_total so a refund matches the per-line rounding of the original invoice. Preserve Decimal arithmetic and the refund_preview response shape, including empty refunds.
tasks.lesson: A previous synthetic invoice correction showed that rounding a combined amount loses the invoice's per-line rounding. Keep Decimal values and sum rounded lines; do not switch to floats.

tasks.task: Fix slice_page: page numbers start at one; each page contains at most size items. Reject page or size below one with ValueError and preserve list_page's items/total response.
tasks.lesson: A previous synthetic pagination correction distinguished the one-based page number from the zero-based slice offset. Validate positive page and size before slicing.

tasks.task: Fix run_with_retry so max_attempts is the total number of calls. Return on success; re-raise the original TransientError when all attempts fail; do not retry other exceptions. Reject max_attempts below one with ValueError.
tasks.lesson: A previous synthetic retry correction found that zero-based loop indices never equal max_attempts. Exhaustion must preserve the last original exception instead of silently returning None.
